5.t: Before plugging machine in, check for any damage which may have occurred during shipping.
With the machine unplugged, open the front and back doors of the Upright Model (unlock and raise table top on Cocktail Model) and check for any internal shipping damage.
Check all connectors to switch units. Logic Board and T.V. Monitor that they are firmly seated.
Inspect Tape Deck Casseite that it is locked in place.

Plug in the machine, deteat the interlock switches by pulling out the activator shaft. At this point the previous game, (X & Q’s) and Question and Answers should be displayed on the CRT. It should be sharp and exhibit the proper levels of brightness and contrast.
Start a game by inserting a coin and touching 1 or 2 player square.
Check game for proper sequence and that all keyboard switches are working properly.
